name: Keynote Glass Blue
summary: Keynote-sting energy in soft white and bright blues: a camera that never rests, frosted-glass boxes and huge frosted titles over sky-blue wallpapers, four coloured squares locking into a cross, directional smears, hard cuts on the beat, and a black end card with the only glow.

palette.use: the main white page
titles and the one key phrase on an answer page (measured from the source's run)
answer-page body text and sub-captions
the 1 px rim of discs and light cards
light windows and caption cards
the top band of a light window
the opening blue haze
ice tints, the haze's lighter end
the soft glow along the bottom of the opening
the wallpaper gradient's deep end
the wallpaper gradient's light end
the app icon's gradient end, dark bars
the send button, the top orbit square, dots, the key word of a title
cyan: an orbit square, dots, scattered light in diagrams
an orbit square, dots
the dark capsule pill
the ice ring round a hovered disc (to #f7feff)
the light-blue flash of a whip-tilt
the grey disc behind the app icon
the black end card's corners
the end card's centre
the end wordmark

type.emphasis: on answer pages the key phrase is black 600 inside grey 400 body; in titles the key word is accent blue

finish.glowOnly: the end wordmark: a tight glow plus a wide soft halo

banned: purple, violet, magenta or orange anywhere
frozen frames, except one short hold on the logo disc
glows on UI text (the end wordmark is the only glow)
Math.random: every random value is seeded
